scientific_integrity: Exact finite polynomial coefficients and minimal-fort size spectra follow from an all-subsets mask induction. An independent implementation directly checks original adversarial-leak propagation over all initial subsets for the four graphs with at most twelve vertices, and all optimal configurations plus deterministic samples on the twenty-vertex graph. Explicit graph-isomorphism certificates are included. Self-review only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Five fixed graph skeletons and vertex leaks only. Previously known framework includes fort duality and a generic exponential counting algorithm; previously known dodecahedral zero- and one-leak minima are credited. The evaluated special polynomials have residual priority uncertainty against differently phrased finite tables. C++17 and Python 3 are required for replay. Independent audit not performed.
title: Two-leak forcing polynomials and fort spectra of the five Platonic graphs
